title: Adaptive Stride- and Streak-Gated Swap Readahead
headline: Screening benchmark: streak gating eliminates speculative readahead on random workloads with -0.96% disk mean and -6.4% zram p99 latency gains.

sections.title: Mitigating speculative readahead penalties on non-contiguous swapin
sections.lead: Standard swap readahead speculatively grows windows on initial faults, penalizing random access. Candidate exp2-stride-gated-ra-v1 introduces strict stride and streak gating before expanding readahead windows beyond 1.

blocks.text: Hypothesis 2 gates swapin readahead expansion in mm/swap_state.c, resetting streak counters and collapsing readahead window on non-contiguous access. Evaluated under Protocol Revision 7 with attributable metadata accounting.

sections.title: Swap readahead heuristic and memory layout
sections.lead: Swap readahead decisions track access strides in VMA readahead state and dynamically compute window size during page faults.

blocks.takeaway: Faulting address determines stride detection and window expansion

sections.title: Streak gating in swap_vma_ra_win and swap_update_readahead
sections.lead: Baseline expands window size aggressively and retains prev_win / 2 on direction changes. Candidate introduces 2+ contiguous hit requirement before win > 1 and immediate collapse to win = 1 on non-contiguous fault.

blocks.takeaway: Non-contiguous faults collapse readahead window to 1 without speculative prefetch

sections.title: Modifications in mm/swap_state.c
sections.lead: Default uninitialized VMA readahead value to 0; in swap_vma_ra_win and swap_update_readahead, require 2+ consecutive contiguous hits before expanding win > 1; immediately collapse win to 1 on stride disruption; in __swapin_nr_pages, bypass window retention on offset discontinuity.

blocks.takeaway: Streak gating eliminates speculative I/O on random access patterns

sections.title: Architectural decision: exploratory screening completed
sections.lead: Candidate passed all 17 correctness gates, probe calibration, and fast screening benchmark. While random tail latency improved by up to 6.4%, modest net gain within noise retains this candidate as an exploratory screen.

blocks.text: The experiment proves that streak gating successfully prevents speculative swapin I/O during random access. Future work should combine streak gating with asynchronous prefetch or larger folio clustering to offset the sequential ramp latency.
